order_reason: The brief fixes this order. The substantive reason matches it: the side is the only market where a points model has anything to say, the total is a score-level claim that is largely independent of the side, and the moneyline is a monotone transform of the same margin distribution, so publishing it first would present a derived number as an independent one.
columns_note: own_line, market_open and market_close are three separate columns; difference_vs_open and difference_vs_close are two more. The difference is never folded into the market column.

side.depth_note: Not applied. The NFL publishes no depth chart and the Game Book lineups are post-game only, so no team's depth state is known before kickoff. See flag DP-02.
